title: How to become a sport psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚取更多的收入，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家完成了他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: What is sport and exercise psychology?
sentences.zh: 什么是运动与锻炼心理学？

sentences.en: And what additional challenges might there be for someone pursuing a professional qualification if they weren't born and raised in the UK?
sentences.zh: 对于一个不是在英国出生长大的人来说，追求专业资质可能会面临哪些额外的挑战？

sentences.en: This is a fascinating episode where we look at the constituent parts of sport and exercise psychology,
sentences.zh: 这是一个引人入胜的节目，我们将探讨运动与锻炼心理学的组成部分，

sentences.en: what the work involves, what the study involves, and what the career options are once qualified.
sentences.zh: 这项工作涉及什么、学习涉及什么，以及获得资格后的职业选择有哪些。

sentences.en: I am joined by Dr. Dawn Marie Ambrose, a qualified sport and exercise psychologist, who has a really interesting story to tell.
sentences.zh: 与我同行的是唐·玛丽·安布罗斯博士，她是一位合格的运动与锻炼心理学家，有一段非常有趣的故事要分享。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I love to be able to introduce you to have deeper dives into different psychology professional areas.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢带大家深入了解不同的心理学专业领域。

sentences.en: And sport and exercise psychology is one that we've not covered very often on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 而运动与锻炼心理学是我们在这个播客中不常涉及的一个领域。

sentences.en: And I still think regardless of what area, the psychology that you want to go into,
sentences.zh: 但我仍然认为，无论你想进入哪个心理学领域，

sentences.en: there is so much to be gained by listening to different practitioners talk, hearing about their life stories.
sentences.zh: 通过聆听不同从业者的谈话和他们的人生故事，都能获得如此多的收获。

sentences.en: So even if sport and exercise psychology is not your passion, I think there is so much that you might find useful about today's episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使运动与锻炼心理学不是你的热情所在，我也认为今天的节目有很多你会觉得有用的内容。

sentences.en: Just after we finished recording, my expert for today, Dr. Dawn, and I were discussing the process of visas.
sentences.zh: 就在我们录音结束刚不久，今天的专家唐博士和我一直在讨论签证流程。

sentences.en: And I came across looking quite naive, but I guess we have to know that we can't always know what we haven't experienced.
sentences.zh: 我当时显得相当天真，但我想我们必须明白，我们不可能总是了解我们未曾经历过的事情。

sentences.en: And every day is a school day.
sentences.zh: 活到老，学到老。

sentences.en: What I hadn't realised is actually it's really quite expensive to get visas to work and study in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我之前没有意识到的是，在英国工作和学习的签证费用其实相当昂贵。

sentences.en: And we're often talking about multiple thousands of pounds.
sentences.zh: 我们经常谈论的是好几千英镑的费用。

sentences.en: And so that is something I hadn't been aware of.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我之前没有意识到的事情。

sentences.en: Did you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Do come and let me know over on socials.
sentences.zh: 快来社交媒体上告诉我吧。

sentences.en: Come and join the free Facebook group, The Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent,
sentences.zh: 快来加入由玛丽安·特伦特博士创建的免费Facebook群组“有抱负的心理学家社群”，

sentences.en: which is the only home of my free weekly videos, Marianne's Motivation and Mindset, which happens on a Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 这里是我每周五上午播出的免费视频《玛丽安的动力与心态》的唯一大本营。

sentences.en: So do come and dive in over there.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要快来这里一探究竟。

sentences.en: With no further ado, let's meet Dr. Dawn.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们来认识一下唐博士。

sentences.en: And I hope you find this a really useful episode.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得这是一期非常实用的节目。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我期待着在节目结束时与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along Dr. Dawn Marie Armstrong, who is a sport and exercise psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 你好，我只想欢迎唐·玛丽·阿姆斯特朗博士，她是一位运动与锻炼心理学家。

sentences.en: Hi, Dawn.
sentences.zh: 你好，唐。

sentences.en: Hi, thank you for the invite today, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 你好，玛丽安，谢谢你今天的邀请。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你答应受访。

sentences.en: I know it's taken us a little while to sort out a date because we're both busy people.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们花了点时间才定下一个日期，因为我们俩都很忙。

sentences.en: But I really wanted to have a think with you about you, obviously, but also what sport and exercise psychology is and how people kind of can begin to explore
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想和你一起探讨一下关于你自身的事情，当然还有什么是运动与锻炼心理学，以及人们如何开始探索

sentences.en: that as a career option.
sentences.zh: 这个职业选项。

sentences.en: So firstly, tell us a little bit about yourself.
sentences.zh: 首先，请跟我们简单介绍一下你自己。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm Dawn.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我是唐。

sentences.en: So for me, I think my journey into the field as a practitioner, presently being transnational.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我认为我作为一名从业者的成长历程，目前来看是跨国界的。

sentences.en: So I am not British.
sentences.zh: 所以我不是英国人。

sentences.en: I am here working as a professional through what would be the international study route.
sentences.zh: 我是通过国际留学途径在这里作为专业人士工作。

sentences.en: I wrote my master's here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里攻读了硕士学位。

sentences.en: Then I completed my doctorate here.
sentences.zh: 然后我在这里完成了博士学位。

sentences.en: And as a result of that, I have been able to capitalize on the opportunities as a skilled worker.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，我能够充分利用作为技术工人的机遇。

sentences.en: Yeah, from the beautiful Caribbean island of Barbados.
sentences.zh: 是的，我来自美丽的加勒比海岛国巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: So I am presently the first from the Caribbean to be on the ACPC register from a BPS accredited doctoral route.
sentences.zh: 因此，我目前是加勒比地区首位通过英国心理学会（BPS）认证的博士路线进入黑尔斯坎特（HCPC）注册名单的人。

sentences.en: And it was no easy undertaking.
sentences.zh: 这绝非易事。

sentences.en: I think for me, when I consider the field of sport and exercise psychology and where my passion came.
sentences.zh: 对我和我的热情所在而言，当我审视运动与锻炼心理学这个领域时，

sentences.en: So my views on what it was when I first started has changed.
sentences.zh: 我对它最初的看法已经发生了改变。

sentences.en: Obviously, now being in the UK, practicing, working.
sentences.zh: 很显然，现在我在英国执业、工作。

sentences.en: And I definitely feel now that the field has evolved to a point where not only do we as professionals focus on the optimization of athletes' potential,
sentences.zh: 我绝对觉得现在的领域已经发展到这样一种地步：我们作为专业人士不仅关注优化运动员的潜力，

sentences.en: we support their well-being, we support performance predominantly.
sentences.zh: 我们支持他们的福祉，我们主要支持表现。

sentences.en: And it all depends on the philosophical underpinnings of the practitioner.
sentences.zh: 这一切都取决于从业者的哲学基础。

sentences.en: Speaking to myself more specifically, I've diversified my practice.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，我使我的实践多样化了。

sentences.en: Not just to focus on, you know, the performance benefits, but to actually utilize my voice as a means of social advocacy within the field.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅关注，你知道的，表现方面的益处，而是真正利用我的声音作为该领域社会倡导的一种手段。

sentences.en: So focusing a lot on equality, diversity and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 因此非常关注平等、多元与包容。

sentences.en: And supporting athletes who are struggling with issues like racism within sport, discrimination.
sentences.zh: 并支持那些在运动中挣扎于种族主义、歧视等问题的运动员。

sentences.en: And really focusing my lens on, you know, marginalized communities within sport.
sentences.zh: 真正将我的视线聚焦于，你知道的，运动中被边缘化的群体。

sentences.en: So I would say typically, yes, working with athletes to optimize potential, but definitely recognizing that in order to optimize the potential of the performer,
sentences.zh: 所以我可以说通常情况下，是的，与运动员合作以优化潜力，但绝对认识到为了优化表演者的潜力，

sentences.en: we first have to focus on them as a human being.
sentences.zh: 我们首先必须把他们当作一个活生生的人来关注。

sentences.en: And looking at some of the challenges that people face, it is sometimes difficult to focus on performance only.
sentences.zh: 审视人们面临的一些挑战，有时很难仅仅关注表现。

sentences.en: So, yeah, well-being and performance, but definitely focusing on those issues that impact us as individuals as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，福祉和表现，但绝对也关注那些影响我们作为个体的议题。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, racism happens to be one of them.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，种族主义恰恰是其中之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And that was something that I discussed with Daniel Gennady, who is a professional football player.
sentences.zh: 这也是我与丹尼尔·杰纳迪讨论过的问题，他是一名职业足球运动员。

sentences.en: And he's also got a first class degree in psychology and he's kind of heading towards the hopefully sport and exercise.
sentences.zh: 他拥有心理学一级荣誉学位，并且他正朝着希望从事运动与锻炼方向努力。

sentences.en: But I asked him about racism in football and he actually said that it's not really something that he's come up against, which kind of made me feel excited for the change, really.
sentences.zh: 我问过他关于足球中的种族主义问题，他实际上说这并不是他真正遇到过的事情，这让我对改变感到有点兴奋。

sentences.en: And it's something I see with my children.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在我的孩子身上看到的。

sentences.en: They just don't seem to see skin colour in the way that I think certainly many of us did when we were younger.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎不像我们年轻时的许多人那样去看待肤色。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know what your experience is of, I mean, you weren't raised in the UK,
sentences.zh: 比如，我不知道你的经验是怎样的，我的意思是，你不是在英国长大的，

sentences.en: but how is that for you as a person of colour, but also supporting people of colour and, you know, probably people who are not, you know, people of colour?
sentences.zh: 但作为一个有色人种，这对你来说是怎样的，同时还要支持有色人种，你知道的，可能还有那些不是有色人种的人？

sentences.en: How is that from your perspective?
sentences.zh: 从你的角度来看，这是怎样的体验？

sentences.en: I think for me coming from a country where I was not a minority, I definitely feel I do have very much a larger than life personality.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，来自一个我不是少数族裔的国家，我绝对觉得自己拥有非常宏大且充满活力的个性。

sentences.en: And I think that's not something that's changed while being in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在身处英国期间并没有改变。

sentences.en: I think having your skin colour politicised is something that I think over the years of being here, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为让你的肤色政治化，是我觉得在英国生活的这些年里，你知道的，

sentences.en: ticking the box to say, oh, you're Black Caribbean, you know, equality and diversity monitoring and, you know,
sentences.zh: 勾选方框说，哦，你是黑人加勒比人，你知道的，平等与多元化监测，你知道的，

sentences.en: all of these other things that you definitely find in Barbados, it's a bit like, OK, well, 95% of us are Black anywhere.
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些你在巴巴多斯肯定也能找到的其他事情，这有点像，好吧，反正我们95%的人都是黑人。

sentences.en: I definitely feel that some people, and it was interesting because I had someone say to me that they just don't understand the issues that some people face.
sentences.zh: 我绝对觉得有些人——有趣的是，有人对我说过他们根本不理解某些人所面临的问题——

sentences.en: And interestingly enough, if people tell you that they're not experiencing racism, chances are, is that they really just don't have the capacity to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，如果人们告诉你他们没有经历过种族主义，很有可能，是他们真的没有能力去处理它。

sentences.en: And oftentimes people overlook some of the things that may happen within their environment, see small microaggressions,
sentences.zh: 通常人们会忽视环境中可能发生的一些事情，看到一些微小的微攻击，

sentences.en: you know, because if you dwell on them and you ruminate, then it has more of a detrimental impact to your performance.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为如果你纠结于它们并反刍，那么它对你的表现会有更多的负面影响。

sentences.en: And this isn't just within sport, this is in general.
sentences.zh: 这不仅在体育界，在日常生活中也是如此。

sentences.en: That some people just choose to overlook some of the things that are happening, whereas some people do the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 有些人只是选择忽视正在发生的事情，而有些人则恰恰相反。

sentences.en: So you and I would both know, considering, you know, psychological evaluation and intake and assessment, it's that individualised approach to the support that you provide.
sentences.zh: 所以你我都清楚，考虑到，你知道的，心理评估和接诊评估，这就是对你提供的支持采取的个性化方法。

sentences.en: So if an individual definitely says, this is what happened to me, you know, it's not up to you to say, well, it is happening.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果个人明确表示，这就是发生在我身上的事情，你知道的，这不取决于你说，嗯，这正在发生。

sentences.en: If that individual believes that this isn't happening and it's not a thing, then we just have to accept that for some people, experiences are different.
sentences.zh: 如果该个人认为这没有发生、不是一回事，那么我们只能接受对某些人来说体验是不同的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, for some of the people that I engage with, it isn't so.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，对于我接触的一些人来说，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: And I focus more on that person-centred approach, because if we are not valuing people as individuals,
sentences.zh: 我更多地关注以人为本的方法，因为如果我们不重视作为个体的每一个人，

sentences.en: sport, for example, and I go on and on and on because of the idealistic nature of it.
sentences.zh: 以体育为例，由于它的理想主义性质，我会喋喋不休地说个不停。

sentences.en: Oh, we don't see colour.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们不看肤色。

sentences.en: You know, everyone is united.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每个人都是团结的。

sentences.en: You know, there's no racism in sport, but people are suffering in the background, unwilling to speak up because they don't want to be victimised and they don't want,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，体育界没有种族主义，但在背后人们却在受苦，不愿发声，因为他们不想成为受害者，也不想要

sentences.en: you know, some of the backlash that comes from speaking about issues like racism.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，谈论种族主义等问题所带来的某些强烈反对。

sentences.en: So that's why I've taken it as a responsibility to speak up, whether or not people believe, you know, you're making an issue of something that's not an issue.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我把它当作自己的责任去发声，无论人们是否相信，你知道的，你在把一件不是问题的事情当作问题。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, it's an issue for many and people just don't want to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，这对许多人来说是个问题，而人们只是不想谈论它。

sentences.en: So, yeah, to answer your question, it has been interesting,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，回答你的问题，这很有趣，

sentences.en: but I'm grateful to have the upbringing that I've had because my identity is more than secure when it comes to dealing with these issues and I think less of critical importance.
sentences.zh: 但我很感激我有过这样的成长背景，因为在处理这些问题时，我的身份认同是非常自信的，我认为这具有次要的重要性。

sentences.en: Thank you for speaking to that point.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你谈到这一点。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was really struck by what you said, you know, in Barbados, actually 95% of people are black.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你所说的话真的让我很震撼，你知道的，在巴巴多斯，实际上95%的人都是黑人。

sentences.en: And so it's that very much experience of now perhaps feeling othered, being in the UK,
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种非常深刻的体验，现在身处英国，可能会感到被边缘化、被当成外人，

sentences.en: even though not 95% of people are white here, there's loads more multicultural kind of aspects, but very different, that feeling of being different or feeling different
sentences.zh: 尽管这里并不是95%的人都是白人，有更多多元文化的方面，但感觉非常不同，那种感到与众不同或感觉自己不同

sentences.en: when actually you're still the same person, but you're in a different setting.
sentences.zh: 而实际上你还是同一个人，但你处在一个不同的环境中。

sentences.en: But, you know, I'm torn, I'm torn between congratulating you for being the first, you know, I think, what did you say?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我很纠结，我在祝贺你成为第一个，你知道的，我想，你刚才说什么？

sentences.en: The first person from the Caribbean who is an HCC registered.
sentences.zh: 第一位来自加勒比地区并获得HCPC注册的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like a BPS road.
sentences.zh: 对，就像是BPS的路子。

sentences.en: So it's just sport and next state psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是运动与锻炼心理学。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I'm torn between congratulating you, but also, I don't know, like a bit dismayed that it's 2024 and you have to be number one, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以我很纠结，一方面想祝贺你，但另一方面，我不知道，比如有点沮丧，现在已经是2024年了，你竟然必须是第一号人物，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: The expense, the investment, again, you know, leaving the Caribbean and being faced with the very real, I'd say, xenophobia sometimes.

sentences.zh: 我不是、我也不是很擅长，但这其实也无所谓。

sentences.en: Um, I really enjoy it after I finished it and my body, my mind responds really well to it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，完成之后我真的很享受，而且我的身体和大脑对此的反应都非常好。

sentences.en: And I have wanted, I've got, I've got two children,
sentences.zh: 而且我一直想要、我有、我有两个孩子，

sentences.zh: 一个10岁，一个7岁。

sentences.zh: 而且这不是那种我以前会觉得自已会喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: So there are practitioners because of the ACPC accredited title of sport and exercise psychologists.
sentences.zh: 所以由于英国心理学会认证的运动与运动心理学家头衔，有一些从业人员。

sentences.en: There are practitioners who are sport and exercise psychologists who predominantly specialize and exercise.
sentences.zh: 有一些从业人员是运动与运动心理学家，他们主要专攻运动领域。

sentences.en: So I think for me, when I engage with clients who are interested in the psychological principles of exercise, I utilize my experience as a sports psychologist predominantly
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得对我来说，当我接触那些对运动心理学原则感兴趣的客户时，我主要是利用我作为运动心理学家的经验

sentences.zh: 来运用这些原则，去协助那些对运动感兴趣的人。

sentences.en: But I don't particularly tell people that I am an exercise psychologist, whereas some of the exercise psychologists that I know predominantly, predominantly work

sentences.en: in, you know, fitness settings, for example, and assisting clients who are somewhat sedentary by applying the principles of behavior change
sentences.zh: 在，你知道的，比如健身环境中，通过应用行为改变的原则来协助那些有些久坐不动客户，

sentences.en: and allowing them to feel empowered as a result of, you know, utilizing exercise to enhance be it well-being.
sentences.zh: 让他们因为你知道的，利用运动来提升哪怕是幸福感而感到充满力量。

sentences.en: Um, obviously in most instances, I think a lot of professionals who specialize in exercise psychology find themselves on exercise referral schemes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很明显在大多数情况下，我认为许多专攻运动心理学的专业人士都会参与运动转诊计划。

sentences.en: So providing that support for persons who, again, may be struggling to, you know, have an active lifestyle and showing them the benefits that can come as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 因此，为那些同样可能在维持积极生活方式方面苦苦挣扎的人提供这种支持，并向他们展示由此带来的好处。

sentences.en: So a lot of persons who have been diagnosed with, like, you know, health issues, for example, who have to exercise, um, psychologists are there

sentences.en: to put interventions in place to support people in that regard.

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, there is tremendous scope for both sport and exercise, but as a practitioner and discussing my sporting history, we've come to recognize

sentences.zh: 而培养出的品格和性格，你知道的，学习团队合作的早期原则，以及，你知道的，尊重并理解
